# Memory Item

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](gmeow-MemoryItem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MemoryItem>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)

An observation/claim in the role of an agent's remembered belief ([`gmeow:memoryOf`](../properties/gmeow-memoryOf.md) the remembering agent; [`gmeow:memoryKind`](../properties/gmeow-memoryKind.md) the cognitive register). A [gufo:Role](../../external/terms.md#gufo-role) on the UNIVERSAL claim construct — any claim form can be remembered, and being remembered is contingent, never an essence. Belief revision is supersession with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false (P10), never deletion: what an agent believed WHEN is a query, not an archaeology project. The substrate under the gmeow client's Memory and the MCP store/recall/revise triad (P14).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](gmeow-MemoryItem.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Grounded Claim

- **Source:** [`slices/core/ai/examples/grounded-claim.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/ai/examples/grounded-claim.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-ai-examples-grounded-claim)#example-slices-core-ai-examples-grounded-claim

```turtle
# The GROUNDED claim: generated by the invocation, attributed to the model,
# pinned to the exact evidentiary bytes. ALSO remembered (MemoryItem role).
ex:claim-close-2200 a gmeow:StandpointClaim, gmeow:MemoryItem ;
    gmeow:vantage ex:assistant ;
    gmeow:observedFeature ex:stmt-2200 ;
    gmeow:observationMethod gmeow:methodLlmExtraction ;
    gmeow:claimModality gmeow:probable ;
    gmeow:wasGeneratedBy ex:invocation-19 ;
    gmeow:wasAttributedTo ex:assistant ;
    gmeow:groundedIn ex:span-close-2200 ;
    gmeow:memoryOf ex:assistant ;
    gmeow:memoryKind gmeow:memoryKindSemantic .
```
